notes: Geographic dataset for the Drawdown US natural gas system map. Point coordinates are site-verified where possible (4 decimals); entries with coords_approx:true are best-effort placements. Basin rings and pipeline paths are ILLUSTRATIVE region shades and flow corridors, not survey geometry. Capacities and production are approximate nameplate/public figures as of mid-2026.

lng_terminals.name: Sabine Pass LNG
lng_terminals.note: Cheniere, 6 trains (~30 mtpa); largest US export terminal

lng_terminals.name: Corpus Christi LNG (incl Stage 3)
lng_terminals.note: Cheniere; Stage 3 midscale trains ramping through 2026

lng_terminals.name: Calcasieu Pass LNG
lng_terminals.note: Venture Global; commercial ops since April 2025 (~10-12 mtpa)

lng_terminals.name: Plaquemines LNG
lng_terminals.note: Venture Global; exporting since Dec 2024, Phase 1+2 ramping to ~20 mtpa

lng_terminals.name: Golden Pass LNG
lng_terminals.note: QatarEnergy/ExxonMobil; first cargo April 2026, Trains 2-3 complete 2026-27 (~18 mtpa)

lng_terminals.name: Port Arthur LNG
lng_terminals.note: Sempra Phase 1 (~13.5 mtpa), first LNG expected 2027; Phase 2 FID'd 2025

lng_terminals.name: Rio Grande LNG
lng_terminals.note: NextDecade, Brownsville Ship Channel; Trains 1-3 (~17.6 mtpa) plus T4-T5 expansion FIDs

lng_terminals.name: CP2 LNG
lng_terminals.note: Venture Global, adjacent to Calcasieu Pass (~20 mtpa); FID 2025

lng_terminals.name: Commonwealth LNG
lng_terminals.note: Caturus; FID May 2026 (~9.5 mtpa), west bank of Calcasieu Pass, ops target 2030

lng_terminals.name: Delfin FLNG (offshore)
lng_terminals.note: Floating LNG deepwater port ~40 mi off Cameron LA; FLNG 1 FID June 2026 (4.4 mtpa), up to 3 vessels (~13.2 mtpa total)

lng_terminals.name: Woodside Louisiana LNG
lng_terminals.note: Formerly Driftwood (Tellurian); Woodside FID April 2025, foundation ~16.5 mtpa, permitted to 27.6 mtpa

lng_terminals.name: Texas LNG
lng_terminals.note: Glenfarne, Brownsville (~4 mtpa); fully subscribed, LNTP issued July 2026, FID imminent

lng_terminals.name: Lake Charles LNG
lng_terminals.note: Energy Transfer (~16.5 mtpa) at former Trunkline import site; development suspended Dec 2025

btm_projects.name: Fermi America Project Matador
btm_projects.note: Amarillo/Carson County, adjacent to DOE Pantex. 11 GW private 'HyperGrid' (gas + nuclear + renewables); first 6 GW of gas preliminarily permitted Nov 2025, first ~1 GW targeted late 2026

btm_projects.name: Homer City Energy Campus
btm_projects.note: Former Homer City coal plant; 7x GE Vernova 7HA.02 turbines, ~$10B+, power from 2027; largest planned US gas-powered DC campus in the East

btm_projects.name: Pacifico Energy GW Ranch
btm_projects.note: Pecos County, ~17 mi north of Fort Stockton; TCEQ air permit for up to 7.65 GW gas approved Feb 2026 — largest permitted DC campus in US; first power target 2027

btm_projects.name: Chevron West Texas Power Campus
btm_projects.note: Chevron + Engine No. 1 + GE Vernova; Permian site, starts 2.5 GW expandable to 5 GW; Microsoft in exclusivity talks (Apr 2026). Exact county not disclosed

btm_projects.name: FO Permian Partners Campus
btm_projects.note: Midland County; 5+ GW off-grid gas power across 3,200-acre platform, announced Mar 2026

btm_projects.name: Stargate Abilene (Crusoe / Lancium)
btm_projects.note: OpenAI/Oracle flagship Stargate site at Lancium Clean Campus; 1.2 GW across 8 buildings (phase 2 completing mid-2026), ~360 MW behind-the-meter gas turbines

btm_projects.name: xAI Colossus (Memphis)
btm_projects.note: Colossus 1 (former Electrolux plant) plus Colossus 2 expansion; mix of onsite gas turbines and dedicated generation. Campus totals evolving rapidly

btm_projects.name: Meta Hyperion (Richland Parish)
btm_projects.note: Meta's largest DC (~$10B, scalable to 5 GW) near Holly Ridge; powered by ~2.3 GW of new dedicated Entergy CCGTs — grid-served but purpose-built gas

btm_projects.name: Williams Socrates (New Albany)
btm_projects.note: Two 200 MW off-grid gas plants in New Albany business park serving a Meta-affiliated DC; in service late 2026; ~$1.6B

btm_projects.name: Vantage Frontier (Shackelford County)
btm_projects.note: ~$25B OpenAI Stargate site announced late 2025; ~1.4 GW campus with substantial onsite gas generation planned. Gas share approximate

pipelines.name: Appalachia to Gulf (TETCO / Columbia Gulf southbound)
pipelines.notes: Illustrative corridor, not a survey route. Reversed/expanded southbound paths feeding Gulf LNG demand.

pipelines.name: Appalachia to Mid-Atlantic (MVP + Transco Zone 5)
pipelines.notes: Illustrative corridor, not a survey route. MVP to Transco Station 165, feeding Southeast/NoVA load.

pipelines.name: Appalachia to NYC / New England (Leidy / TGP-Algonquin)
pipelines.notes: Illustrative corridor, not a survey route. NE PA takeaway toward NYC and constrained New England.

pipelines.name: Permian to Gulf Coast (Whistler / Matterhorn corridor)
pipelines.notes: Illustrative corridor, not a survey route. Combined Waha-to-Agua-Dulce/Katy takeaway (Whistler, Matterhorn, PHP, GCX and expansions).

pipelines.name: Haynesville to Gulf (Gulf Run / LEAP to Gillis)
pipelines.notes: Illustrative corridor, not a survey route. North Louisiana south to the Gillis hub and LNG corridor.

pipelines.name: Canada to Midwest (Alliance / Northern Border)
pipelines.notes: Illustrative corridor, not a survey route. WCSB imports into the Chicago market area.

pipelines.name: Rockies to Midwest (REX)
pipelines.notes: Illustrative corridor, not a survey route. Rockies Express mainline; Zone 3 now flows bidirectionally with Appalachian gas moving west.

pipelines.name: Gulf Coast to Atlantic Seaboard (Transco mainline)
pipelines.notes: Illustrative corridor, not a survey route. Transco mainline through the Southeast to NoVA and NYC; stylized system-level figure.
